senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very much, excessively many.
E.
बहु much, इष्ठन् superlative aff., form irr.

mfn. (यान्-यसी-यः)
Very many.
E.
बहु much, ईयसुन् superlative aff.

(बनु) r. 8th cl. (बनुते)
To ask or beg, preferably written वन.

r. 9th cl. (बध्नाति) r. 10th cl. (बन्धयति)
To bind or tie;
with आङ् prefixed,
To loosen, to let loose.
With अनु,
1 To follow.
2 To be affixed or attached to.
With नि,
to disunite.
With सम,
to connect.

m. (-न्धः)
1 A pledge, a deposit.
2 A binding, a tie or fetter, &c.
3 Binding, tying.
4 The body.
E.
बन्ध to tie, aff. अच्.

n. (-कं)
1 Exchanging, barter.
2 A city.
3 A binding.
4 Binding, confinement.
m. (-कः)
A pledge.
f. (-की)
1 An unchaste woman, a harlot, a wanton.
2 A barren woman.
3 A she elephant.
E.
बन्ध to bind, ण्वुल् aff. fem. aff. ङीप्.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A complete army, or one with its four divisions, of chariots, elephants, horse, and foot.
E.
बन्ध binding, तन्त्र an army.

n. (-नं)
1 Binding, tying, confining.
2 A rope for tying cattle.
3 Killing.
4 Hurting, injuring.
mfn. subst. (नः-ना or नी-नं)
The implement of binding or tying, a rope, a chain, a bandage, a ligature, &c.
E.
बन्ध to tie, aff. ल्युट् or बुच्.

m. (-न्थिः)
1 A rope for tying cattle.
2 The knot of a ligature.
E.
बन्धन tying, and ग्रन्थि a knot.

f. (-ज्जुः)
1 A rope for tying cattle, &c.
2 Any rope or string used for tying.
E.
बन्धन tying, रज्जु a rope.

n. (-श्म)
A prison.
E.
बन्धन confinement, and वेश्मन् a house.

m. (-यः)
A prison.
E.
बन्धन confinement, and आलय abode.

m. (-म्भः)
The post to which an elephant is tied.
E.
बन्ध a binding, and लम्भ a post.

n. (-त्रं)
Love, desire.
E.
बन्ध to bind, इत्र Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्धुः)
1 A kinsman, a relation, but especially a distant or cognate kinsman, and subsequent in right of inheritance to the gentile or Sagotra; the Bandhu, is of three kinds; the kinsman of the person himself, of his father, or his mother, as his father's brother's son, and his mother's sister's or brother's son; and the same reckoning upwards, as his father's father's sister's son, &c.
2 A friend.
3 A brother.
4 A flower, (Pentapetes phænicea.)
E.
बन्ध to bind or connect, उ aff.

m. (-कः)
A flower: see बन्धूक.

m. (-कः)
1 A shrub bearing a red flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea, but also applied to the Ixora Bandhuca.).
2 A tree, (Pentaptera.)
E.
बन्ध to bind, ऊक aff.

m. (-नः)
A relation, a friend.
E.
बन्धु, and जन a person.

m. (-वः)
A flower, (Pentapetes Phoenicea.)
E.
बन्धु a friend, जीव to live, aff. अच्; also कन् being added, बन्धुजीबक (-कः)

f. (-ता)
1 A multitude of relations.
2 Relationship.
E.
बन्धु a kinsman, and तल् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Relationship.
E.
बन्धु, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, बन्धुता.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Given by a kinsman.
n. (-त्तं)
One kind of female property, that given to a girl at her marriage by her own relations.
E.
बन्धु, and दत्त given.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Uneven, undulating, wavy, partially even, and depressed.
2 Bowed, bent.
3 Pleasing, delightful, handsome, beautiful.
4 Deaf.
5 Injurious, mischievous.
m. (-रः)
1 A goose.
2 A flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea.)
3 A drug, commonly Bireng.
4 A bird.
5 A crane.
6 A drug, commonly Ṛṣabha.
n. (-रं)
1 A diadem, a crest.
2 The dregs of oil, or oil cake.
f. (-रा)
A whore, a prostitute.
f. plu. (-राः)
The meal of parched corn.
E.
बन्ध to bind, उरच् Uṇādi aff.; also with ऊरच्, aff. बन्धूर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Wavy, undulating, uneven.
2 Bowing, bent.
3 Beautiful, handsome.
m. (-रः)
A hole, a chasm.
E.
बन्ध to bind, Uṇādi aff. ऊरच्; also वन्धुर.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Friendless, relationless.
E.
बन्धु, and हीन devoid of.

m. (-ष्पं)
A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
E.
बन्धूक the Pentapetes or Ixora, and पुष्प flower; having a similar flower.

m. (-लिः)
A flower, (Pentapetes, &c.): see बन्धूक.
E.
वन्ध, and ऊलिच् aff.

mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं)
1 Barren, unfruitful, not bearing fruit in due season.
2 Detained, confined, under arrest.
f. (-न्ध्या)
1 A childless woman.
2 A barren cow.
3 A perfume, commonly Bālā.
E.
बन्ध to bind, aff. यत्.

m. (-यः)
A bastard, the son of a disloyal wife.
E.
बन्धकी a wanton, aff. ढक्, and इनङ् augment.

m. (-वः)
1 A relation, a kinsman: see बन्धु.
2 A friend.
E.
बन्धु a kinsman, अण् pleonastic aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Calling upon or bewailing a kinsman.
E.
बान्धव, and आक्रोशिन् who calls aloud.
